title: Module 2 encapsulation: generator parameters
description: Parameters of cad/generators/m2_encapsulation.py (DRAFT design, after CapSeq Fig. 1B and the SPC methods paper). Flows in uL/h, lengths in mm unless the name says _um. x-source: where the default comes from ('the sheet' = the project's geometry requirements sheet); 'Assumption' marks a placeholder.

capsule_count.description: N: capsules to make (sizing.py 'mvp' preset). Sizes the finishing trap and the run time.

nozzle_depth_um.description: Nozzle depth (and the droplet section's channel depth).
nozzle_depth_um.x-source: SPC-NAR, via the sheet (40 um deep x 40 um wide)

core_flow_ul_h.description: Core stream: cells in the viscous core buffer, from Module 1b.

shell_flow_ul_h.description: Shell stream: the photocrosslinkable hydrogel precursor.

oil_flow_ul_h.description: Oil, split between both sides of the nozzle.

cell_conc_per_ul.description: Cells per uL in the core stream (for the sizing summary; Module 1b sets the real value).

y_junction_angle_deg.description: Angle between the core and shell arms at the Y-junction.

coflow_length_mm.description: Side-by-side (co-flow) channel from the Y-junction to the nozzle.

coflow_width_um.description: Co-flow channel width (core + shell side by side).

inlet_width_um.description: Core, shell and oil inlet channel width.

separation_length_mm.description: Straight phase-separation channel after the nozzle.

separation_width_um.description: Phase-separation channel width (carries droplets: >= 1.5 x capsule diameter).

separation_depth_um.description: Phase-separation channel depth (deeper than the nozzle so droplets aren't squashed).

inlet_filters.description: Passive pillar filter on each inlet.

cell_filter_gap_um.description: Inlet filter pillar gap; must be smaller than the nozzle.

delay_tubing_id_mm.description: Inner diameter of the off-chip delay tubing (for the suggested length).

trap_mesh_um.description: Finishing-trap mesh opening; must be < 0.4 x capsule diameter.

aggregate_filter_gap_um.description: Pillar gap of the capsule-aggregate filter on the way out.
